Title:

Team Member Names: Annabelle Adachi, Ebyan Hussein

This project will explore trends in music popularity by analyzing data from the Billboard Top 100 chart. 

Research Questions:
- How do trends in popular music change over time?
- What are some of the most popular phrases used in song titles by genre?
- How does the popularity of certain genres change over time?

Reason for choosing topic: We were curious about trends in what kind of music is most popular.

Data Set: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ludmin/billboard/versions/131 

Communication Plan: In-person in class or before/after class and Google Chat

Roles:
- Point of Contact: Ebyan
- Technical Lead: Annabelle and Ebyan
- Style Lead: Annabelle

Conflict resolution: We will rely on clear communication to resolve any issues. We both have a shared goal of completing this project and doing a good job. We will hold each other accountable.

Implementation Plan:
1. Load and wrangle data
2. Make preliminary univariate visualizations to decide which variables we want to explore
3. Refine research questions
4. Create multivariate visualizations for each of the research questions
5. Format visualizations according to effective visualization guide
6. Create data story incorporating the visualizations and all elements of the required report structure
